claims.claim: finds him hiding in closet with jam on his hands
claims.evidence: she seizes him ('I might 'a' thought of that closet'); 'It's jam'; he flees over the fence - he is not 'hiding' and doesn't 'slip away' from her grasp until a trick
claims.fix: catches him coming out of the closet with jam on hands and mouth, and he escapes over the fence

claims.claim: plays truant, Sid tells on him
claims.evidence: text: Tom goes swimming; Polly spots the black thread; 'She'd never noticed if it hadn't been for Sid'; 'truant' not stated
claims.fix: Sid gives him away over the black thread on his collar
